newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five as Atlantic Panamaxes continue active.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five as Atlantic Panamaxes continue active.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up five to 1,354 points on Tuesday as active trading of Panamaxes for grain continued in the Atlantic.

Brokers said Egyptian charterers fixed 1977-built Orjen 72,000 dwt prompt US Gulf trip Egypt at $8,500 daily plus $190,000 bonus and the 1977-built Anthi P 64,900 dwt delivery US Gulf mid-July was reported at $9,000 daily plus $200,000 bonus to Soufflet.

There was heavy demand for Panamax tonnage from Argentina/Brazil to the Far East. Andre fixed Ilenao 64,400 dwt prompt Denmark in this trade at $13,000 daily and other charterers were said to be negotiating similar rates.
The Caper market remained subdued although rates were steady but Handy-sizes in the Atlantic continued weak with reports of 30,000 grain 53 ft fixed Brazil to Continent at only $15.50.
The Baltic Handy Index was down two to 1,015.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 12 to five points higher in the active positions which traded 22 lots.
